ORDER BY rowid',\n        [campaign_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        { id: row['id'], kind: row['kind'], summary: row['summary'] }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.event_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_quest(campaign_id, id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_faction(campaign_id, id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_factions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND quantity > 0', [campaign_id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.campaign_friendly_npcs_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_npcs WHERE campaign_id = ? AND disposition > 0', [campaign_id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.campaign_quests(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'SELECT * FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY rowid',\n        [campaign_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        {\n          campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n          id: row['id'],\n          title: row['title'],\n          status: row['status'],\n          milestones: json_column(row, 'milestones_json'),\n          completed_milestones: json_column(row, 'completed_milestones_json')\n        }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.campaign_quests_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) }\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign inventory ---\n\n  def self.add_inventory_item(campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        existing = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n        )\n        if existing\n          new_quantity = existing['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        party_row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n        return false unless party_row && party_row['quantity'] >= quantity\n\n        new_party_quantity = party_row['quantity'] - quantity\n        if new_party_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_party_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        end\n\n        existing_char = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n        if existing_char\n          new_char_quantity = existing_char['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_char_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.inventory_summary(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      party_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      assigned_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions = db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'healing-potion', 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions_available = healing_potions ? healing_potions['quantity'] : 0\n\n      {\n        party_items: party_items,\n        assigned_items: assigned_items,\n        healing_potions_available: healing_potions_available\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign sessions ---\n\n  def self.campaign_session_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_campaign_session(campaign_id, id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY starts_at ASC LIMIT 1', [campaign_id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      id: row['id'],\n      starts_at: row['starts_at'],\n      duration_minutes: row['duration_minutes'],\n      agenda: json_column(row, 'agenda_json')\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.campaign_sessions_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.save_attendance(campaign_id, session_id, present, absent)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO campaign_session_attendance (campaign_id, session_id, present_json, absent_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, session_id, JSON.dump(present), JSON.dump(absent)]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_attendance(campaign_id, session_id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_session_attendance WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_project(campaign_id, id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      id: row['id'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      item_slug: row['item_slug'],\n      days_required: row['days_required'],\n      days_completed: row['days_completed'],\n      status: row['status'],\n      cost_gp: row['cost_gp']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_project(campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, cost_gp)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_crafting_projects (campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, days_completed, status, cost_gp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, 0, 'active', cost_gp]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.advance_project(campaign_id, id, days)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        row = db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id])\n        return nil unless row\n\n        new_completed = [row['days_completed'] + days, row['days_required']].min\n        status = new_completed >= row['days_required'] ? 'complete' : 'active'\n\n        db.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_crafting_projects SET days_completed = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n          [new_completed, status, campaign_id, id]\n        )\n\n        if status == 'complete'\n          existing = db.get_first_row(\n            'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n          )\n          if existing\n            db.execute(\n              'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n              [existing['quantity'] + 1, campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n            )\n          else\n            db.execute(\n              'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n              [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party', 1]\n            )\n          end\n        end\n\n        { id: row['id'], days_completed: new_completed, status: status }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaigns ---\n\n  def self.play_campaign_exists?(id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_play_campaign(id, name, owner, max_players)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaigns (id, name, owner, status, phase, max_players, current_actor, turn_number, queue_json, nudge_count, story, dm_notes, current_scene_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [id, name, owner, 'lobby', nil, max_players, nil, nil, JSON.dump(nil), 0, '', '', nil]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign(id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      id: row['id'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      owner: row['owner'],\n      status: row['status'],\n      phase: row['phase'],\n      max_players: row['max_players'],\n      current_actor: row['current_actor'],\n      turn_number: row['turn_number'],\n      queue: json_column(row, 'queue_json'),\n      nudge_count: row['nudge_count'],\n      current_scene_id: row['current_scene_id']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign_document(id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT story, dm_notes FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n    return { story: '', dm_notes: '' } unless row\n\n    {\n      story: row['story'] || '',\n      dm_notes: row['dm_notes'] || ''\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.update_play_campaign_document(id, story, dm_notes)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET story = ?, dm_notes = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [story, dm_notes, id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign members ---\n\n  def self.play_campaign_member_exists?(campaign_id, username)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? 'dm' : 'player'\n\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET status = ?, phase = ?, current_actor = ?, turn_number = ?, queue_json = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        ['active', phase, current_actor, turn_number, JSON.dump(queue), id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign_member(campaign_id, username)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?', [campaign_id, username]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      username: row['username'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      class: row['class']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.increment_nudge_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute('UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = nudge_count + 1 WHERE id = ?', [campaign_id])\n      db.get_first_value('SELECT nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [campaign_id])\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign narrations ---\n\n  # Inserts a single narration/action/resolution event and returns its\n  # sequence number. Sequence numbers are per-campaign and monotonically\n  # increasing so the log order matches insertion order.\n  def self.insert_narration(campaign_id, kind, actor, type, text)\n    with_db do |db|\n      sequence = (db.get_first_value('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) FROM play_campaign_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) || 0).to_i + 1\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, text]\n      )\n      sequence\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_narration(campaign_id, actor, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'narration', actor, nil, text)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_action(campaign_id, actor, type, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'action', actor, type, text)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_resolution(campaign_id, actor, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'resolution', actor, nil, text)\n  end\n\n  def self.play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'SELECT sequence, kind, actor, type, text FROM play_campaign_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY sequence ASC',\n        [campaign_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        result = { sequence: row['sequence'], kind: row['kind'], actor: row['actor'] }\n        result[:type] = row['type'] if row['type']\n        result[:text] = row['text']\n        result\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign turn advancement ---\n\n  def self.update_play_campaign_turn(campaign_id, current_actor, phase, turn_number)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, phase = ?, turn_number = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [current_actor, phase, turn_number, campaign_id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign scenes ---\n\n  def self.scene_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_scenes WHERE campaign_id = ? The implementation is\nintentionally minimal and deterministic: no background jobs, no external\nservices, and a single SQLite database file.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nbundle install\nPORT=4567 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` starts the server in the foreground on `127.0.0.1` using the `PORT`\nenvironment variable. The same port is also read by `app.rb` as a fallback, but\n`run.sh` always passes it on the command line.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n```\n\nExpected response:\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": true }\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n```\napp.rb              # Sinatra application, route definitions, request helpers\nlib/\n  auth.rb           # Bearer-token authentication and password hashing\n  game_logic.rb     # Pure D&D 5e calculations and encounter constants\n  storage.rb        # SQLite persistence layer\n  validation.rb     # Input validation helpers\nrun.sh              # Foreground server launcher\nGemfile             # Pin: sinatra 4.2.1, rack 3.2.6, puma 8.0.2, sqlite3 2.9.5\n```\n\n`app.rb` requires the four libraries, configures the server bind address and\nport, initializes the SQLite schema, and then registers the helper modules and\nroutes. The app uses **classic Sinatra** style (`require 'sinatra'` and routes\ndefined at the top level) so that `ruby app.rb` works directly.\n\n## State, persistence, and request-routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db` (SQLite). The `Storage` module owns every\nSQL statement and the single shared database connection. Key facts:\n\n- `Storage::DB_PATH` resolves to the project-root `game.db`.\n- `Storage::DB_MUTEX` serializes all database access because Puma may serve\n  requests concurrently and the Ruby `sqlite3` connection object is not\n  thread-safe for unsynchronized use.\n- `Storage::SCHEMA_VERSION` is `1`. It is recorded in the `schema_info` table on\n  first boot.\n- JSON is stored as text columns (`*_json`) and parsed/serialized by the\n  storage layer. `Storage.json_column(row, column, default)` centralizes the\n  parse step; `Storage.ensure_column!(db, table, column, definition)` runs the\n  incremental schema migrations.\n\nSchema is created on boot by `Storage.init_schema!`. Tables are created with\n`IF NOT EXISTS`, so restarts are safe. The `POST /v1/storage/reset` endpoint\n(and `Storage.reset!`) drops and recreates all tables for tests.\n\nTables:\n\n- `combat_sessions` — turn order, active round/turn, and per-target conditions.\n- `users` — username, password hash, role (`dm` or `player`).\n- `compendium_monsters` — stat blocks keyed by slug, including JSON tags.\n- `compendium_items` — magic items keyed by slug.\n- `campaigns` — campaign id, name, and DM username.\n- `campaign_characters` — party members belonging to a campaign.\n- `campaign_events` — session notes and open thread entries.\n- `campaign_quests` — quest headers, milestones, and completed milestones.\n- `campaign_factions` / `campaign_npcs` — factions and their NPCs.\n- `campaign_inventory` — party and per-character item quantities.\n- `campaign_crafting_projects` — downtime crafting state.\n- `campaign_sessions` / `campaign_session_attendance` — scheduled sessions and\n  attendance lists.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members`, `play_campaign_narrations` —\n  owned live-play campaigns, party membership, and ordered narration/action/\n  resolution events. `play_campaigns` also stores the durable `story` and\n  `dm_notes` campaign document, plus turn queue/turn-number state.\n- `play_campaign_locations` / `play_campaign_location_connections` — owned\n  location graph nodes and directed outbound travel edges per campaign.\n\n### Routing\n\nSinatra routes are grouped by domain in `app.rb`:\n\n1. Health\n2. Core dice/checks (`/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`,\n   `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order`)\n3. Characters (`/v1/characters/*`)\n4. Combat state (`/v1/combat/sessions/*`)\n5. Auth users (`/v1/auth/*`)\n6. Storage (`/v1/storage/*`)\n7. Compendium (`/v1/compendium/*`)\n8. Campaigns (`/v1/campaigns/*`) — including quests, factions/NPCs, inventory,\n   downtime crafting, and session scheduling\n9. PHB rules (`/v1/phb/*`)\n10. DM tools (`/v1/dm/*`)\n11. Campaign analytics (`/v1/campaigns/:id/analytics/*`) and audit/export\n12. Play campaigns (`/v1/play/campaigns/*`) — lobby, party membership, turn\n    queue, GM/player turn views, actions, resolutions, the campaign document,\n    and location graph\n\nEvery successful route that returns JSON calls `content_type :json` before\nproducing the body. Error halts use `json_error(status, message)`, which sets\nthe `application/json` content type and a JSON body `{\"error\":\"...\"}`. The\n`/v1/dice/stats` route is the only validation halt that omits the explicit\ncontent type, preserving the original behavior.\n\n### Helper modules\n\nSinatra helper modules are included in `app.rb`:\n\n- `GameLogic` — pure functions (ability modifier, proficiency, initiative order,\n  encounter XP/difficulty). These methods have no side effects and can be unit\n  tested in isolation.\n- `Validation` — input guards that may `halt` with a 400 response. They depend on\n  the request context through the `json_error` helper.\n- `Auth` — bearer-token extraction and role enforcement; password hashing via\n  `OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac`. Uses `json_error` for 401/403 halts.\n\nApp-specific helpers live in the anonymous `helpers` block in `app.rb`:\n\n- `parse_json_body` — read and parse JSON, halt 400 on parse errors.\n- `find_combat_session!` — load a combat session or halt 404.\n- `combat_session_response(session, extra = {})` — format a session for the\n  public API; optional extra keys can be merged (e.g. `conditions`).\n- `json_error` — uniform JSON halt helper.\n- `require_campaign_exists!(campaign_id)` — validate the id and halt 404 unless\n  the campaign exists.\n- `load_play_campaign!(campaign_id)` — load a play campaign or halt 404.
